hydrograph-camels: Two-panel chart for the Piscataquis River near Dover-Foxcroft, ME, water year 1996-10-01 to 1997-09-30. Top: observed daily discharge (cyan) with a sharp peak of about 249 cubic metres per second on day 63 and a broad rise to about 120 near day 200; the dashed Lyne-Hollick baseflow (alpha 0.925) stays far below the peaks and the quickflow is the shaded gap, BFI 0.394. Bottom: basin precipitation in millimetres per day as bars hanging from the top, up to about 43 millimetres on day 63.
